tiers.name: Machine-Verified
tiers.rule: Automated test passes and reproduces deterministically by running the repository verification suite.

tiers.name: Proved in Paper
tiers.rule: Complete mathematical derivation or structural proof in the canonical LaTeX manuscript, human-verified.

tiers.name: Numerically Verified
tiers.rule: Consistent across seeded numerical sweeps and ensembles, not yet established as an unconditional theorem.

tiers.name: Explicitly Falsified
tiers.rule: Computation or structural proof shows the conjecture is false. Preserved in the append-only Elimination Ledger; never hidden.
